<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Enable DeepSeek V4 DSpark speculative decoding on NPU Ascend 950 (arch35). The existing DSpark implementation only supported CUDA and older NPU (arch22). Arch35 hardware requires different sparse-attention operators, weight-loading strategies, and numerical compatibility workarounds. Several follow-up fixes address a regression where DSpark's unquantized `wo_a` path conflicted with the arch35 MXFP8 detection logic, plus NPU-specific numerical gaps.

## Modifications

- **arch35 DSpark sparse attention**: Added arch35-specific v2 sparse attention operators via a new `TorchOpLoader` extension; loaded during TP worker and DSpark draft worker initialization.
- **`wo_a` quantization fix**: `use_npu_arch35_mxfp8_wo_a()` now accepts a `wo_a_keeps_quant_config` parameter and returns `False` when DSpark explicitly disables `wo_a` quantization. This fixes a regression introduced by a previous commit that changed the assertion condition from `if fp8:` to `if quantize_wo_a:`, which caused an incorrect assertion on arch35 because DSpark's `wo_a` was not quantized. The model also caches this value instead of recomputing it at each call site.
- **DSpark stage configuration**: Added `_dspark_stage_config()` to apply draft-specific expert counts to draft stages and disable vision layers for text-only stages. Arch35 now falls back to standard vocabulary/fusion behavior instead of the arch31-specific path.
- **Weight loading**: Moved the NPU `weight_packed` → `weight` rename before stacked parameter mapping, eliminating duplicated branch logic.

## Accuracy Tests

| Model | Dataset | Metric | Subset | Num | Score |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 | GPQA-Diamond | Accuracy ↑ | gpqa_diamond | 198 | 89.9% |

## Speed Tests and Profiling
| Model | Dataset | Num | Avg Lat | Avg TTFT | Avg TPOT | Avg Thpt | Avg In | Avg Out |
|---|-----|------|---------|---------|---------|----------|------|-----|
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash| GPQA-Diamond | 198 | 149.111 s | 1943.3 ms | 14.3 ms | 67 tok/s | 344 | 9991 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
